children.name: text-1
children.text: Hello, everyone!

children.name: text-1
children.text: Before we start our lesson today, let's think about a few questions:

children.name: text-1
children.text: What is your favorite ice cream flavor? Why?

children.name: text-1
children.text: What is the best movie ever? How come?

children.name: text-1
children.text: What is the yuckiest snack? Why do you say so?

children.name: text-1
children.text: Today we will:

children.name: text-1
children.text:
Review opinion writing

Explore how to plan and arrange ideas for opinion writing effectively

Support opinions with facts and other details

Study an example of an opinion piece

children.name: text-1
children.text: Review: What is Opinion Writing?

children.name: text-1
children.text: A piece of writing wherein an author expresses their thoughts/ feelings about a particular topic

children.name: text-1
children.text: How do you express an opinion?

children.name: text-1
children.text: You can use key words that signal that you are expressing your personal feelings/thoughts, like:

children.name: text-1
children.text: Opinion Speed Round

children.name: text-1
children.text:
In this activity, you will state your state your opinion on a given topic and support it with a reason!

Pair up, and face each other. You will be given exactly ONE minute each to express your opinion and support it with a reason!

After one minute, switch roles. If you agree with your partner's opinion, you must try to think of a different reason why!

Actively listen and show respectful engagement when your partner is expressing their opinion.

children.name: text-1
children.text: Let's read a sample opinion paragraph:

children.name: text-1
children.text:
"Recycling: the best way to save the Earth!"

I believe recycling is important because it helps protect our planet. First, recycling plays a big role in preserving our natural resources. Instead of cutting down trees, we can reuse paper and plastic! Additionally, recycling reduces waste. Recycling keeps trash out of landfills, which helps keep our air and water clean! Lastly, recycling conserves energy. It takes less energy to make things from recycled materials instead of starting from scratch.
